title: Hourly electric-grid balance and forecasts
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete official January-June 2025 balance CSV; all balancing authorities and published fields retained.

measurement_dates.description: 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30 hourly reporting window, with source local/UTC endpoint fields.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Published balancing-authority operational products include author/agency imputations and adjustments. All variants are preserved; no additional imputation or correction was performed.
known_analyses_and_limitations: EIA grid accounting is already documented. Demand-generation-interchange equalities are accounting identities, not discoveries. Timestamp conventions, reporting gaps and fuel-category revisions may introduce apparent relationships.
